title: Traffic event detection
runtimeNote: Timings are from the last completed full run before the final signal-rule and seed changes. The current code still needs a successful all-video timing run.

signalAblation.note: Same detections and dev labels; mixed red/green samples stay unknown after the fix.

scene.notes: Coordinates in the C3905 scene_ref.jpg (1920x1080), synced from CVAT task 2623023. The near approach has a curbside right-turn lane plus four through lanes, ordered curb to median. The right-turn path is directed from approach to the lower-left branch. The left two-lamp head is a pedestrian signal; other turn restrictions remain unknown.

near.comment: Across all near approach lanes; front bumper defines crossing.

B_far.comment: Crossing over the right-hand branch road; the B_far key is historical, not the far carriageway.

veh_main.comment: Median-side front-facing signal; red/amber/green for near approach.

left_red_green.comment: Pedestrian standing/walking icons. Its red phase begins before vehicle red; never use this head for red_light or stop_line.

gantry_left_back.comment: Back of overhead signal; phase not visible.

gantry_right_back.comment: Back of overhead signal; phase not visible.

queue_near.comment: approach before near stop line: congestion / queue

junction.comment: Full visible conflict area from near stop line through side-road and crossing B/C.

bus_stop_far.comment: Far-side bus berth; berth dwell is not a stopped_vehicle event.

near_curb_lane_end.comment: Near-side lane boundary becomes continuous on stop-line approach; partly occluded.

near_median_edge.comment: Yellow edge line along raised median; no vehicle crossing.

far_outer.comment: Far-side sidewalk curb, partly hidden by trees.

island_B.comment: Keep-right island between crossings A and B.

island_C_inner.comment: First pedestrian refuge island by lower crossing.

island_C_outer.comment: Second pedestrian refuge island by lower crossing.

near_crossing_A.comment: Only red-light stop before the line is permitted.

near_curb.comment: Curbside turn-only lane; right turn from the driver’s direction.

near_through_1.comment: Near-approach through lane 1, ordered curb to median.

near_through_2.comment: Near-approach through lane 2, ordered curb to median.

near_through_3.comment: Near-approach through lane 3, ordered curb to median.

near_through_4.comment: Near-approach through lane 4, ordered curb to median.

near_right.comment: Directed from the near approach into the lower-left branch; a right turn from the driver’s direction.

datasetNote: Manually reviewed development labels for rule validation; not a held-out test set.
